login.title: Sign in with Plex
login.text: Access is limited to users of the Plex server this app runs on.
login.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the Plex window…
login.denied: This account has no access to this Plex server.
login.timeout: No confirmation from Plex within 2 minutes
login.expired: the sign-in session expired or was started in another browser

filters.recommendedHint: Picked for you from your Plex watch history

browse.noData: The guide has not been downloaded yet.
browse.noRecommendations: No recommendations: your account has no watch history on this Plex server yet.
browse.recommendationsPending: Recommendations are being prepared from your watch history. Check back in a few minutes.

ignored.title: Hidden
ignored.text: Titles and episodes that no longer show up in the list or in emails.
ignored.confirmClearAll_one: Restore {{count}} hidden entry? Everything will show up in the list again.
ignored.confirmClearAll_other: Restore {{count}} hidden entries? Everything will show up in the list again.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.text: When something from this list shows up in the guide, you get an email. For shows, only episodes you don't have yet and aren't scheduled are reported.
wishlist.searchPlaceholder: Type a movie or show title…
wishlist.phraseHint: A phrase matches every title that contains it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emailHint: Defaults to your Plex account email.
settings.alertsHint: Sent as soon as something from your wishlist appears in the guide.
settings.digestHint: After the nightly refresh: everything new in the guide (excluding hidden, scheduled and titles you have).
settings.smtpMissing: Email is not configured (SMTP_HOST is missing).
settings.recsHint: The 20 best titles to record from the whole guide, picked from your Plex watch history (excluding hidden, scheduled and titles you have).

email.alertIntro: These titles from your wishlist showed up in the TV guide:
email.digestIntro: New titles in the guide since the last email:
email.testBody: This email confirms that notifications work.
email.footer: You can change notification settings in RecPick.
email.recsIntro: Picked from the whole guide based on what you watch on Plex:

support.text: Enjoying RecPick? You can buy me a coffee.

rules.text: A rule hides everything that matches all of its conditions: in the list, in alerts, in the daily email and in recommendations. Within one condition (e.g. genres) any of the picked values matches.
rules.name: Name
rules.channelHint: With channels, only the airings on those channels are hidden. A title disappears when it has no airings left on other channels.
rules.missingHint: Titles with no year, rating or country never match those conditions. Pick “Unknown country” to hide titles TMDB doesn't know.
rules.matches_one: Hides {{count}} title in the current guide
rules.matches_other: Hides {{count}} titles in the current guide
rules.fromFiltersHint: Creates a rule that hides what these filters show
rules.missingHintNoTmdb: Titles with no year never match a year condition.
